items.name: base
items.title: Dualkit base
items.description: Tokens, component styles, icons and the direction helpers every Dualkit component shares.
items.docs: Import components/dualkit/tokens.css, then components/dualkit/styles.css, once in your root layout. Set lang and dir on <html>: lang="ar" dir="rtl" switches to Arabic type and mirrors the layout.

items.name: amount
items.title: Amount
items.description: Money in all six Gulf currencies, isolated from the sentence, with Arabic-Indic digits in Arabic.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Forward and back icons flip with the reading direction; close and check never do.

items.name: date-display
items.title: Date display
items.description: Gregorian with Umm al-Qura Hijri, pinned to Gulf time.

items.name: digit-input
items.title: Digit input
items.description: One-time code boxes that read Western, Arabic-Indic and Persian digits, typed or pasted.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A text field whose value keeps its own direction, so an email or IBAN stays left to right in an Arabic form.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal side sheet from the inline end: right in English, left in Arabic. Traps focus and swipes back to close.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: WAI-ARIA tabs where the arrow keys follow the reading direction.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A status toast that swipes away towards the inline end and pauses on hover and focus.

items.name: gulf-field
items.title: Gulf field
items.description: The label, note and caret handling the gulf inputs share.
items.docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.

items.name: gulf-phone-input
items.title: Gulf phone input
items.description: A phone number from any of the six GCC countries. Reads Arabic-Indic digits, returns E.164 and stays left to right in Arabic.
items.docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.

items.name: gulf-iban-input
items.title: Gulf IBAN input
items.description: Groups a Gulf IBAN in fours as it is typed and checks its length and checksum for each country.
items.docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.

items.name: gulf-national-id-input
items.title: Gulf national ID input
items.description: An Emirates ID number, hyphenated as it is typed and checked against the 784 prefix and check digit.
items.docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.

items.name: gulf-amount
items.title: Gulf amount
items.description: An amount in AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, BHD or OMR, with three decimals for the dinars and the rial and Arabic or Western digits.
items.docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.

items.name: gulf-hijri-date
items.title: Gulf Hijri date
items.description: A date typed once and shown in Gregorian and Umm al-Qura Hijri. The time zone is required.
items.docs: Needs a shadcn project (Tailwind and the shadcn CSS variables). Works with and without `shadcn init --rtl`: set dir="rtl" on <html> or a parent for Arabic. Pass every label, help text and error message as props.
